[[File:Mystifying_Hoop_Trick.png|thumb|right|250px|Wim and Bellina Magwit perform the Mystifying Hoop Trick]]
{{Quote|Now, to finish tonight's show, I'm joined by my beautiful wife Bellina and the performing Magwit children as -- by popular request -- we perform the Magnificent Magwit's Mystifying Hoop Trick!|Wim Magwit|<ref name="Bar-Kooda">''[[Boba Fett: Bounty on Bar-Kooda]]''</ref>}}
The '''Mystifying Hoop Trick''' was the grand finale of [[Wim Magwit]]'s [[Magic/Legends|magic]] show. At the close of every show, Magwit used his [[Magwit's Mystifying Hoop|hoop]]&mdash;which was an advanced [[matter transmitter]]&mdash;to make first his wife, [[Bellina Magwit|Bellina]], and then his children, disappear from the stage. This was swiftly followed by his [[Bird/Legends|birds]] and then himself.<ref name="Bar-Kooda" />
